description: This Java class 'ChatManager' handles socket communication for a WiFi Direct chat application. It manages reading from and writing to socket buffers, running in a separate thread, and communicates with the UI thread via a Handler.

classes.name: ChatManager
classes.description: Manages socket communication for reading and writing messages in a WiFi Direct chat application, able to run in its own thread.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the socket reading loop, reads incoming data, and passes it to the UI thread via Handler.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Sends a string message over the socket's output stream in a separate thread.
